_comment: Emoji ZWJ sequences in project names. Read by apps/control-plane/tests/project-create.test.ts (validator + POST /v1/projects) and by a web client's validator tests, so both rules stay equivalent. Escapes keep every invisible code point reviewable. A skin-tone modifier before a ZWJ needs a pictographic base before it.

reject.label: ZWJ after an emoji, before a letter
reject.name: 👩‍x

reject.label: ZWJ after a letter, before an emoji
reject.name: x‍💻

reject.label: standalone skin-tone modifier then ZWJ (no pictographic base)
reject.name: 🏽‍💻

reject.label: skin-tone modifier, U+FE0F, ZWJ, emoji (no base)
reject.name: x🏽️‍💻

reject.label: two skin-tone modifiers after the base, then ZWJ
reject.name: 🧑🏽🏽‍💻
